characters.name: Gandalf
characters.description: A powerful wizard of Middle-earth, known as Gandalf the Grey and later Gandalf the White.

characters.name: Sauron
characters.description: The Dark Lord, creator of the One Ring, and primary antagonist of The Lord of the Rings.

characters.name: Aragorn
characters.description: The heir of Isildur, ranger of the North, and future King of Gondor.

characters.name: Legolas
characters.description: Elven prince of Mirkwood, master archer, and member of the Fellowship.

characters.name: Frodo Baggins
characters.description: The Ring-bearer who carried the One Ring to Mount Doom.

characters.name: Samwise Gamgee
characters.description: Frodo's loyal gardener and companion, the true hero of the quest.

characters.name: Gimli
characters.description: Dwarf warrior, son of Glóin, and member of the Fellowship.

characters.name: Saruman
characters.description: The White Wizard who fell to darkness, seeking the One Ring for himself.

characters.name: Galadriel
characters.description: Lady of Lothlórien, bearer of Nenya, one of the Three Elven Rings.

characters.name: Boromir
characters.description: Captain of Gondor, son of Denethor, who succumbed to the Ring's temptation.

characters.name: Gollum
characters.description: Formerly Sméagol, corrupted by the One Ring over centuries.

characters.name: Elrond
characters.description: Lord of Rivendell, bearer of Vilya, and wise Elf-lord.

characters.name: Théoden
characters.description: King of Rohan, freed from Saruman's influence by Gandalf.

characters.name: Éowyn
characters.description: Shieldmaiden of Rohan who slew the Witch-king of Angmar.

characters.name: Faramir
characters.description: Captain of the Rangers of Ithilien, younger brother of Boromir.

characters.name: Treebeard
characters.description: The oldest Ent of Fangorn Forest, shepherd of the trees.

characters.name: Witch-king of Angmar
characters.description: Lord of the Nazgûl, Sauron's most powerful servant.

characters.name: Durin's Bane (Balrog)
characters.description: Ancient demon of shadow and flame, awakened in Moria.

characters.name: Tom Bombadil
characters.description: Enigmatic being of unknown origin, master of the Old Forest.

characters.name: Glorfindel
characters.description: Mighty Elf-lord of Rivendell, who faced the Witch-king at the Ford.

characters.name: Haldir
characters.description: Marchwarden of Lothlórien, guardian of the Golden Wood.

characters.name: Beregond
characters.description: Soldier of Gondor who saved Faramir from Denethor's madness.

characters.name: Halbarad
characters.description: Ranger of the North, kinsman of Aragorn, bearing his standard.

characters.name: Erkenbrand
characters.description: Lord of the Westfold, defender of Helm's Deep.

characters.name: Gríma Wormtongue
characters.description: Treacherous counselor of Théoden, spy for Saruman.

synergies.name: The Fellowship
synergies.description: Assemble the legendary Fellowship of the Ring.

synergies.name: The Dark Lord
synergies.description: Sauron and his chief servants united.

synergies.name: The White Council
synergies.description: The wisest beings of Middle-earth in council.

synergies.name: Kings of Middle-earth
synergies.description: The rightful rulers of the free peoples.

synergies.name: The Two Hobbits
synergies.description: Frodo and Sam, bound by loyalty and friendship.
